questions.stem: A man is referred for fever and agitation for the past 4 days. Examination reveals a disoriented man who is unable to swallow water due to involuntary inspiratory muscle spasms of the pharynx. He had been bitten by a dog 3 months ago but was not treated. What genus does the causative organism of this condition belong to?
